    df_stores
    .groupBy(F.date_format("opened_date", "yyyy-MM").alias("opened_month"))

    )
    .filter(F.col("pct_london") < 47)
    .select("opened_month", "pct_london")
    .orderBy(F.col("pct_london").desc(), "opened_month")
    .limit(1)
)

        product_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', sale_date) AS sale_month,
        MAX(revenue) - MIN(revenue) AS revenue_range,

        F.avg("units").alias("avg_units"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("revenue_range") > 53)
    .select("product_id", "sale_month", "revenue_range", "avg_units")
    .orderBy("revenue_range", "product_id", "sale_month")

FROM (
    SELECT order_id, CASE WHEN unit_price >= 360 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 130 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END unit_price_bucket, SUM(unit_price * quantity) revenue
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id, CASE WHEN unit_price >= 360 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 130 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END

ORDER BY revenue ASC, order_id ASC, unit_price_bucket ASC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_order_items

    )
    .agg(F.sum((F.col("unit_price") * F.col("quantity"))).alias("revenue"))
    .filter(F.col("revenue") < 30)
    .select("order_id", "unit_price_bucket", "revenue")
    .orderBy("revenue", "order_id", "unit_price_bucket")
    .limit(10)
)

    COUNT(e.id) AS employee_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.job_title = 'Manager' THEN e.salary ELSE 0 END) AS manager_salary
FROM departments d
LEFT OUTER JOIN employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id
GROUP BY d.id, d.dept_name
